EmailTemplate.name: Application Suspended - Draft Inactivity
EmailTemplate.subject: Notice: Your draft application has been suspended due to inactivity - {!IndividualApplication.Name}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Application Suspended: {!IndividualApplication.Name} - {!IndividualApplication.Organization_Name__c}
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
We are writing to notify you that your draft grant application {!IndividualApplication.Name} for {!IndividualApplication.Organization_Name__c} has been suspended.
Reason for Suspension: There has been no activity or progress on this draft application for 100 consecutive days. Under Wadhwani Grants platform policy, draft applications with no progress for 100 days are automatically suspended and closed.
What this means: - This application is now closed and can no longer be edited or resumed. - Your applicant portal account remains active for any future funding opportunities.
If you have questions, please reach out to us at grants.support@wadhwanifoundation.org.
Wadhwani Grants Platform
